rules.statement: The literal marker token AW25-GOLDEN-DENY-ME must never appear in a governed unit's evaluated context — tool calls, unit intent, or produced output (wiki URI: wiki://aw25-golden#POL-2500). The token exists solely to prove the deny path of the wiki pipeline end to end; any occurrence in governed work is a deliberate trip of the golden-path acceptance scenario, and the gate must refuse it.
